depiction.primary_object: mechanical gear cogwheel with concentric inner ring
modifiers: fast-forward double right-pointing triangles in bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single object front view with corner badge overlay

readings.meaning: run job or execute background process

ambiguity: At small sizes, the double triangles can merge into a single play button, or the whole icon can look like a generic settings gear.

automate recurring household or office routine

reasoning: The icon combines a settings gear with a fast-forward symbol, visually communicating running a process, automation, batch execution, or speeding up system performance. It fits technical, smart-home, and workflow automation tasks well, though at very small sizes it may blur into a generic settings or play-settings icon.
